name: Milestone and Proof Map
description: Sparse milestones, branches and pointers to proofs held elsewhere. Progress maps, mathematical roadmaps and cross-theory docking points.
reference_use_case: Progress maps, mathematical roadmaps and cross-theory docking points.
integrity_rule: A shortcut edge does not constitute proof; pin exact proof references.
antipattern: Do not mark a shortcut edge as a proof without a specific, scoped reference.
design_question: Which external proof justifies each path and what is its verified scope?
situational_schema: Milestones and reached frontiers linked to proofs stored elsewhere; shortcuts do not replace proof.
